maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is commissions and fees from placing new specialty insurance for brokers and carriers, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are retail brokers, agents and carriers; premiums are paid by private businesses and individuals, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic through hiring teams and launching underwriting units; bolt-on acquisitions are supplementary, per its own site.

mission_critical.reason: Wholesale brokerage placements and binding authority can be moved to other wholesalers; brokers can switch fairly easily.

notes: Serial acquirer and mission-critical are judgment calls; delegated underwriting programs may be stickier, and it does make regular bolt-ons.
